'''Ebenn Q3 Baobab''' was a [[human]] author and linguist who wrote the ''[[Easy Ubese Phrase Book]]''. Baobab served as a dignitary for the [[Royal House of Naboo]]. In [[32 BBY]] Baobabhe was part of a group who stood with [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] to greet the passengers of the [[CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle]] ''[[Perpetuus]]'' when it landed in the [[city]] of [[Theed]].

==Biography==
Ebenn Q3 Baobab<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref> was a [[human]]<ref name="TPM" /> dignitary of the [[Royal House of Naboo]]. Baobab worked as a linguist and studied the [[language]]s of living and long-extinct [[species]],<ref name="OM91" /> authoring the ''[[Easy Ubese Phrase Book]]''.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> Following the defeat of the [[Trade Federation]] during the [[Battle of Naboo]]<ref name="TPM" /> in [[32 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Baobab was amongst a group who stood with [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] in the world's [[capital]] [[city]], [[Theed]], in order to greet the passengers of the<ref name="TPM" /> [[CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle]] ''[[Perpetuus]]''.<ref name="Vehicles">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]''</ref> Once the [[shuttle]] landed, Amidala gave some parting words to the captured leaders of the Federation, [[Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]] and [[Settlement Officer]] [[Rune Haako]], before they were escorted away to the shuttle.<ref name="TPM" />

The [[queen]] then greeted [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], who had traveled from [[Coruscant]] with the [[Jedi High Council]].<ref name="TPM" /> Amidala's daughter, [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], later requested a copy of Baobab's [[book]] from [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service|Alliance Intelligence]] as part of her preparation for a [[Rescue of Han Solo|mission]] to rescue the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]]<ref name="Rebel Files" /> while disguised as the [[Ubese]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]] in [[4 ABY]].<ref name="Date" />

==Personality and traits==
Baobab had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and graying brown [[hair]].<ref name="TPM" />

==Equipment==
He wore a black and gold [[Clothing|outfit]] and a crimson and gold [[hat]].<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ebenn Q3 Baobab was portrayed in a cameo appearance by sound designer [[Ben Burtt]]<ref name="BtoB">{{SW|url=news/from-boonta-to-baobab-droids-and-the-star-wars-prequels|text=From Boonta to Baobab: ''Droids'' and the ''Star Wars'' Prequels|nolive=1}}</ref> in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> The scene was filmed during planned pickup shots at [[Leavesden Studios]] in [[1998]].<ref name="Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character's name was used in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]],<ref name="Rebel Files" /> but it originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where Burtt created it himself for his [[2001]] reference book [[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']].<ref name="Guide">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref> Burtt used the name Baobab to link his cameo to the character [[Mungo Baobab]] from the ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'' television show.<ref name="BtoB" />

In ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'', author [[Adam Bray]] named the model of airbrushes used by [[Sabine Wren]] in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' television show as the [[Baobab EZ3 Airbrush]] after Ebenn Q3 Baobab, intending to suggest that "EZ3" was a descendant of "EQ3" Baobab.<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|authoradambray|1315472080473735168|[[Adam Bray]]|quote=I designated Sabine Wren's (@tiyasircar) airbrush model: "Baobab EZ3" after Ben Burtt's artist character, Ebenn Q3 Baobab (EQ3), suggesting he'd have a descendant by now (EZ3). Manufactured by Neco Jeyrroo's (anagram of my friend Star Wars artist @Joe_Corroney) Artisan Supplies.|archivedate=20210428153626}}</ref>
